annotations.title: Sample rows from a public table

description: The publisher's materialized preview of a table — real rows, no account, no query cost. 20 rows by default, 100 at most, and they are always the same rows: this is a sample for understanding shape and values, NOT a query. Example: {"table_id": "0f2f6bfa-4a63-4f75-9a0b-1a7d9c5b2e10", "limit": 20}. Returns {table, columns, rows, row_count, total_row_count, sample_truncated} — total_row_count is how many rows the whole table holds, which is usually far more than the sample. To filter, sort, aggregate or read beyond the sample, use query_table, which needs a workspace key.
